capture_method: Actual native SwiftUI views rendered in fresh, agent-owned headless CoreSimulator devices; xcrun simctl io <owned-device-udid> screenshot <path>. No image generation, compositing, cropping, resizing or UI redesign.

toolchain.runtime_build_evidence: Active iPad SIMULATOR_ROOT and RuntimeRoot/System/Library/CoreServices/SystemVersion.plist; both devices created with the same runtime identifier.

accepted_slots: iPhone with Dynamic Island (large display): 1320 x 2868
apple_specification.requirement: PNG without alpha; 13-inch screenshots required for apps that run on iPad.

fixtures.isolation: New UUID-scoped synthetic stores and UserDefaults suite per launch; DesignPreviewEngine rejects download, preparation and recognition; AppController verificationMode=true; fixture controls have hit testing disabled.
fixtures.content: Synthetic example transcripts, history dates/durations, dictionary rules, installed/prepared model states. Completed transcript demonstrates editable text, including manually edited punctuation; it is not recognition output or an accuracy claim.
fixtures.privacy: No physical phone, user data, microphone capture, clipboard, recognition or model download was used.

temporary_source_instrumentation.change: Removed only the three-line DEBUG simulator preview-banner Text view below during the single capture build; restored original source immediately after successful build.
temporary_source_instrumentation.removed_exact_text:
Text(context.fixtureError ?? "Design preview · synthetic text and model states")
                .font(.system(size: 11)).foregroundStyle(AppTheme.inkSecondary)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity).padding(.vertical, 3).background(AppTheme.canvas)

build.command: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project LocalScribe.xcodeproj -scheme LocalScribe -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath DerivedDataStoreScreenshots -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath DerivedDataStoreScreenshots/SourcePackages -disableAutomaticPackageResolution -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -skipPackageUpdates -jobs 2 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
build.result: BUILD SUCCEEDED; one build; existing pinned SourcePackages/cache cloned to owned ignored DerivedData; no dependency or SDK installation.

postprocessing.iphone: CoreGraphics/ImageIO removed unused alpha channel; asserted original alpha=255 throughout and verified decoded RGB equality.
postprocessing.ipad: Python standard-library PNG unfilter/re-encode removed unused alpha channel; asserted original alpha=255 throughout and exact decoded RGB equality. Existing sips independently confirmed dimensions and hasAlpha=no.
postprocessing.preserved: Original pixel dimensions, RGB pixels and color-profile metadata; no visual content changed.

verification.visual: All eight final PNG files opened with view_image: legible native text and controls, expected navigation, no preview banner, unintended dialog, spinner or unintended text clipping. History excerpt ellipsis and Models scrolling are native.
verification.file_format: All eight independently checked with sips: accepted dimensions and hasAlpha=no; PNG IHDR color type 2 (RGB), bit depth 8.
verification.cleanup: Both owned simulator devices shut down; tracked source restored; asset-only commit.
verification.limits: Screenshot evidence establishes rendered UI only. No speech-runtime, microphone, keyboard-insertion, background-dictation, accessibility-conformance, hardware speed, energy or accuracy verification was performed. Dictate CPU/memory/headroom values are actual simulator-process sampler values (including simulator-reported 0.0 MiB headroom), not model benchmarks. Models load-time/RAM values remain Not measured; installed/loaded labels are synthetic fixture state.

store_selection.root_review: Root visually inspected all eight final PNGs. Dictate retained as QA evidence, excluded from the Store listing because the native verification fixture shows Not ready / Mic off, Retry and simulator-only headroom. No screenshot content was altered to hide these native states.
